title: Concept: Obsolete TLS/SSL version named (universal) — review required
description: Naming SSLv[23]b|TLSv1.[01]b keeps a broken protocol negotiable or documents its acceptance. Each obsolete version carries practical attacks (POODLE, BEAST-class, weak record handling). The remedy is TLS 1.2+ only.
applicability: TLS configuration and version checks; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Downgrade to broken protocols; MEDIUM severity.
